pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Close the provider-coupling gap identified by the CAP Core v1 freeze research in PR #165 without introducing a generic Provider framework.

Base: PR #169 / `research/direct-semantic-mutation-gate`.

The public Chat surface remains exactly six tools.

## Problem

PR #165 selected this stable direction:

```text
stable semantic capability
 -> CAP Core authority/state/verification
 -> capability-specific adapter seam
 -> provider implementation
```

but `runtime/semantic-projection/bin/semantic-projection.mjs` still directly owned:

- `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` package resolution;
- `@playwright/mcp` package resolution and launch arguments;
- MCP client/stdio lifecycle;
- concrete downstream provider tool names;
- provider connection caching/closure.

That meant adding or replacing a provider still required editing the semantic projection itself.

## Change

Introduce exactly two capability-specific provider seams:

- `filesystem-semantic-provider.mjs`
  - owns the reviewed Filesystem MCP package/lifecycle/tool allowlist;
  - exposes only `roots/readText/search/writeText`.

- `playwright-browser-semantic-provider.mjs`
  - owns the reviewed Playwright MCP package/lifecycle/tool allowlist;
  - exposes only `navigate/find/snapshot/click/type/takeScreenshot/mouseClickXY`.

The semantic projection now depends only on those bounded capability methods.

The same-session visual click path was also moved from raw `client.callTool(...)` access to the bounded browser provider interface so raw Playwright tool dispatch does not leak back through the vision fallback.

## Explicit non-goals

No:

- ProviderRegistry;
- dynamic provider discovery;
- plugin framework;
- EventBus;
- new public tool;
- new authority/grant;
- new persistence;
- retry/reconciliation change;
- WorkingState change;
- provider selection by Chat/model input;
- Rust Native Host implementation.

This is a dependency-boundary refactor under the architecture already selected by #165.

## Guard

Tests/workflow now enforce that the main semantic projection cannot directly contain:

- `@playwright/mcp`;
- `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`;
- `StdioClientTransport`;
- the old generic `callBackend(...)` dispatch.

The provider files are included in both packaged and installed semantic bundles.

## Core-freeze status

This closes the concrete provider-embedding gap identified by #165.

It does **not** by itself declare Core v1 frozen. A separate remaining audit item is the existing consequence-bearing `windows_case_update_v1` path, which still needs disposition against the #166/#167 exact Core authorization contract before a truthful freeze claim.

## Sequencing

```text
#159
 -> #165
 -> #166
 -> #167
 -> #168
 -> #169
 -> this PR
 -> remaining Core consumer disposition
 -> Core v1 freeze
 -> refresh/rebase #170 Native Host research
```

Do not merge this stacked PR before its prerequisites are accepted.
